lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 8 distinct vertical white line segments are visible across the lateral torso. Spacing is non-uniform, with segments in the mid-torso showing narrower gaps compared to the anterior and posterior segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the third vertical line segment from the anterior edge, splitting in the upper-mid quadrant of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first, third, and eighth vertical segments are discontinuous, terminating before reaching the dorsal ridge or ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 4 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior flank, situated in the lower haunch region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lower haunch align horizontally to form a short, semi-connected geometric line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate, spiral trajectory, curving posterodorsally then medially toward the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 2.8 times the pixel width of the individual horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips constitute approximately 15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three distinct white spots on the facial region (two on the cheek, one on the lower jaw); white transverse bands on the proximal portion of the limbs; long, dark ventral hair fringe.
